Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: How many teams participate in the Turkish Women's Football Super League, and what is the format of the league?

target_age: "15-18"
story_style: "educational"
language: "Indonesian"

Context:
The Turkish Women's Football Super League (Turkish: Kadınlar Süper Ligi), formerly the First Women's Football League (also known as the Turkcell Women's Football Super League for sponsorship reasons), is the top level women's football league of Turkey. In the 2022–23 season, one group of 10 teams and one group of nine teams play a double round robin and finals to decide a champion club, which qualifies for a spot in the UEFA Women's Champions League.On 8 March 2021, the International Women's Day, the Turkish Football Federation signed a sponsorship agreement with the Turkish mobile phone operator Turkcell. Accordingly, the First Women's Football League was named Turkcell Women's Super League (Turkish: Turkcell Kadın Süper Ligi) beginning with the 2021–22 season.

Format
In an effort to increase quality of the league, in the 2009–10 season two teams were relegated and four teams were promoted to the first league. Thus, the 2010–11 season consisted of twelve teams. Fashion One TV became the official media sponsor of the league for the 2010–11 season. At this time the league gained little attention in Turkey. After playing two groups with six teams and then having a championship and relegation group, the 2012–13 season was played as a double-round robin with ten teams again. The winner after 18 games was the champion and qualifies for the UEFA Women's Champions League, the bottom two teams get relegated. In 2016–17 there again was introduced a championship and relegation round after the regular season.
For the 2019-20 league season, the number of participating teams was increased from ten to twelve again after eight seasons. No relegation was planned to take place, so that the planned number of teams would be achieved with two promoted teams from the Women's Second League. However, Trabzon İdmanocağı had to be relegated since they did not show up in the entire previous season. To replace them, a third team from the Second League was promoted. All three women's leagues of the 2019-20 season were stopped on 8 March 2020 due to COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey.Due to the ongoing pandemic, the 2020-21 season of the Women's First Football League, after renaming the Turkcell Women's Football League, will take start with delay on 17 April 2021. The season was dedicated to healthcare workers, and named 2021 Turkish Turkcell Women's Football League Healthcare Workers' Season (Turkish: 2021 Sağlık Çalışanları Futbol Ligi). The league consisted of 16 teams, including all the 12 teams from the previous season and 4 teams promoted from the Second League's previous season. The teams were divided into four groups of four teams each, with one promoted team in each group. Each team in the group played only three matches in a round-robin tournament. The top two teams of the four groups play quarter-finals and semi-finals in Single-elimination tournament. The winner of the final match, on 4 May 2021, represented Turkey at the 2021–22 UEFA Women's Champions League.

{"item_idx": 23, "source": "Roanoke and Tar River Railroad", "language": "id", "question_raw": "Question: When was the Roanoke and Tar River Railroad fully merged into the Seaboard Air Line Railway network, and what happened to the line after that?", "question": "When was the Roanoke and Tar River Railroad fully merged into the Seaboard Air Line Railway network, and what happened to the line after that?", "user_message": "Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: When was the Roanoke and Tar River Railroad fully merged into the Seaboard Air Line Railway network, and what happened to the line after that?", "context_type": "v1+v2_merged_dedup", "merged_contexts": ["The Roanoke and Tar River Railroad was a railroad running from Boykins, Virginia south to Lewiston, North Carolina, a distance of 36 miles.
The Roanoke and Tar River Railroad was chartered by the North Carolina State Legislature in 1871 though no action to construct the line happened until 1885, when the charter was reissued.  It would operate as a subsidiary of the Seaboard and Roanoke Railroad, which it connected with at the north end in Boykins.  Construction began in 1887 and was complete a year later.In 1892, the Murfreesboro Railroad was built, which branched off the Roanoke and Tar River Railroad at Pendleton and ran to Murfreesboro, North Carolina.  The Roanoke and Tar River Railroad would acquire the Murfreesboro Railroad in 1893 and operated it as a branch line until 1897.  When they discontinued service on the branch, the town of Murfreesboro took action to prevent the abandonment. ## Petualangan Melintasi Batas Pengetahuan: Kisah GPT-4

"Anak-anak," Bu Rina memulai dengan senyum, "kita akan menyelami salah satu inovasi paling menarik di dunia kecerdasan buatan. Mungkin kalian sudah familiar dengan ChatGPT, kan?"

Siswa-siswa mengangguk. Beberapa bahkan mengangkat tangan, ingin berbagi pengalaman mereka menggunakan ChatGPT untuk tugas sekolah atau sekadar bersenang-senang.

"Nah, bayangkan ChatGPT itu seperti mobil sport yang cepat dan cerdas," lanjut Bu Rina. "Sekarang, bayangkan ada versi terbarunya, yang jauh lebih kuat, lebih pintar, dan bisa melakukan hal-hal yang sebelumnya tidak kita duga. Itulah GPT-4!"

"Kapan GPT-4 dirilis, Bu?" tanya Rio, seorang siswa yang selalu ingin tahu.

Bu Rina menekan tombol pada papan tulis holografiknya, dan sebuah tanggal besar muncul: **14 Maret 2023**.

"Tepat pada tanggal 14 Maret 2023, OpenAI, perusahaan di balik semua ini, meluncurkan GPT-4. Awalnya, ia tersedia dalam bentuk terbatas melalui ChatGPT Plus, versi premium dari ChatGPT yang kalian kenal, dan juga melalui API untuk para pengembang yang mendaftar di daftar tunggu. Ini seperti peluncuran roket baru; tidak semua orang bisa langsung menaikinya, tapi dampaknya terasa ke seluruh dunia."

"Jadi, apa bedanya dengan versi sebelumnya, Bu?" tanya Sarah, yang lebih tertarik pada kemampuan praktisnya. "Apakah hanya lebih cepat?"

"Itu pertanyaan bagus, Sarah!" kata Bu Rina. "Perbedaannya sangat signifikan. Ingat, GPT-4 adalah penerus dari model-model sebelumnya: GPT-1 di tahun 2018, GPT-2 di tahun 2019, dan GPT-3 di tahun 2020, yang kemudian disempurnakan menjadi GPT-3.5 yang menjadi dasar ChatGPT. Setiap versi adalah lompatan besar, dan GPT-4 ini adalah lompatan yang sangat besar."

Bu Rina menampilkan beberapa poin penting tentang kemampuan GPT-4:

### Kemampuan Luar Biasa GPT-4:

1.  **Lebih Andal, Kreatif, dan Paham Instruksi Rumit:**
    "OpenAI sendiri mengatakan bahwa GPT-4 'lebih andal, kreatif, dan mampu menangani instruksi yang jauh lebih bernuansa daripada GPT-3.5'. Bayangkan kalian memberi instruksi pada asisten AI kalian, dan dia tidak hanya memahaminya dengan baik, tapi juga bisa memberikan hasil yang lebih imajinatif dan sesuai konteks yang sangat spesifik."

2.  **Jendela Konteks yang Jauh Lebih Besar:**
    "Salah satu peningkatan paling penting adalah 'jendela konteks'-nya. Ini seperti memori jangka pendek model tersebut. GPT-3.5 hanya bisa mengingat sekitar 4.096 'token' (kata atau bagian kata). GPT-4 punya dua versi, dengan jendela konteks 8.192 atau bahkan 32.768 token! Ini berarti dia bisa memproses dan memahami informasi dari teks yang jauh lebih panjang, seperti seluruh bab buku atau dokumen hukum yang rumit, tanpa kehilangan jejak."

3.  **Model Multimodal: Melihat dan Memahami Gambar!**
    "Ini adalah terobosan besar! Berbeda dengan pendahulunya yang hanya bisa menerima teks, GPT-4 adalah model 'multimodal'. Artinya, ia bisa menerima **gambar dan teks sebagai input**. Bayangkan ini: kalian bisa mengunggah meme dan meminta GPT-4 menjelaskan mengapa meme itu lucu, atau mengunggah tangkapan layar dari grafik dan memintanya meringkas informasi di dalamnya. Bahkan, ia bisa menjawab soal ujian yang berisi diagram!"

    Bu Rina menampilkan contoh di mana GPT-4 berhasil menjelaskan humor dari gambar aneh dan meringkas teks dari screenshot.

4.  **Pesan Sistem untuk Kendali yang Lebih Baik:**
    "OpenAI juga memperkenalkan 'pesan sistem' baru. Ini seperti memberi instruksi awal kepada GPT-4 tentang 'persona' atau 'tugas' apa yang harus diembannya. Misalnya, kalian bisa menyuruhnya, 'Bertindaklah seperti bajak laut Shakespearean,' dan semua jawabannya akan keluar dalam prosa berima ala Shakespeare. Atau, 'Selalu berikan jawabanmu dalam format JSON,' dan dia akan melakukannya. Ini memberi kita kendali yang luar biasa atas bagaimana model itu berinteraksi."

5.  **Berinteraksi dengan Antarmuka Eksternal:**
    "GPT-4 tidak hanya terpaku pada apa yang sudah ada di dalam 'otaknya'. Jika diinstruksikan, ia bisa berinteraksi dengan antarmuka eksternal. Misalnya, kalian bisa memintanya melakukan pencarian web untuk mendapatkan informasi terbaru, dan hasilnya akan dimasukkan ke dalam responsnya. Ini membuka pintu untuk melakukan banyak hal di luar prediksi teks biasa, seperti menggunakan API lain, menghasilkan gambar, atau mengakses dan meringkas halaman web."

6.  **Asisten Coding yang Canggih:**
    "Bagi kalian yang tertarik dengan pemrograman, GPT-4 adalah alat yang luar biasa. Para programmer menemukan bahwa ia sangat membantu dalam tugas coding, seperti menemukan kesalahan dalam kode yang sudah ada atau menyarankan optimasi untuk meningkatkan kinerja. Seorang biofisikawan bahkan mengatakan bahwa waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk memindahkan program dari MATLAB ke Python berkurang dari berhari-hari menjadi 'sekitar satu jam' berkat GPT-4!"

7.  **Lulus Ujian Standar dengan Nilai Tinggi:**
    "GPT-4 menunjukkan kemampuan luar biasa dalam berbagai ujian standar. Dalam pengujian OpenAI sendiri, model ini mendapatkan skor 1410 pada SAT (persentil ke-94), 163 pada LSAT (persentil ke-88), dan 298 pada Ujian Bar Seragam (persentil ke-90). Bandingkan dengan GPT-3.5 yang jauh di bawahnya. Ia bahkan lulus ujian onkologi, teknik, dan bedah plastik!"

8.  **Aplikasi Medis Revolusioner:**
    "Para peneliti dari Microsoft menguji GPT-4 pada masalah medis dan menemukan bahwa tanpa perlu instruksi khusus, ia melampaui nilai kelulusan USMLE (ujian lisensi dokter di AS) dengan lebih dari 20 poin! "Wow, itu gila!" seru Dani, ternganga. "Jadi, GPT-4 itu seperti ensiklopedia berjalan yang bisa melihat dan berbicara?"

"Kurang lebih begitu, Dani," Bu Rina tersenyum. "Tapi, penting untuk diingat bahwa ia juga punya keterbatasan."

### Keterbatasan GPT-4:

1.  **Halusinasi:**
    "Seperti pendahulunya, GPT-4 bisa 'berhalusinasi'. Artinya, ia bisa menghasilkan informasi yang tidak ada dalam data pelatihannya atau bahkan bertentangan dengan instruksi kalian. Jadi, jangan langsung percaya semua yang dikatakannya tanpa verifikasi, terutama untuk informasi penting."

2.  **Kurangnya Transparansi:**
    "Kita tidak tahu persis bagaimana ia membuat keputusan. Meskipun ia bisa memberikan penjelasan, penjelasan itu seringkali dibuat 'setelah kejadian' dan tidak selalu mencerminkan proses sebenarnya. Terkadang, penjelasannya bahkan bertentangan dengan pernyataan sebelumnya."

3.  **Bias yang Tersembunyi:**
    "Karena dilatih dengan data dari internet, ia bisa saja memiliki bias yang sama dengan data tersebut. OpenAI sudah berusaha menguranginya dengan 'reinforcement learning from human feedback' untuk menolak permintaan yang berbahaya, tapi beberapa bias kognitif seperti bias konfirmasi masih bisa muncul."

"Jadi, meskipun sangat pintar, kita tetap harus kritis ya, Bu?" tanya Rizal.

Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: When was GPT-4 released and what are some of its capabilities?

target_age: "15-18"
story_style: "educational"
language: "Indonesian"

Context:
Generative Pre-trained Transformer 4 (GPT-4) is a multimodal large language model created by OpenAI, and the fourth in its numbered "GPT-n" series of GPT foundation models. It was released on March 14, 2023, and has been made publicly available in a limited form via the chatbot product ChatGPT Plus (a premium version of ChatGPT), and with access to the GPT-4 based version of OpenAI's API being provided via a waitlist. As a transformer based model, GPT-4 was pretrained to predict the next token (using both public data and "data licensed from third-party providers"), and was then fine-tuned with reinforcement learning from human and AI feedback for human alignment and policy compliance.: 2 Observers reported the GPT-4 based version of ChatGPT to be an improvement on the previous (GPT-3.5 based) ChatGPT, with the caveat that GPT-4 retains some of the same problems. Unlike the predecessors, GPT-4 can take images as well as text as input. OpenAI has declined to reveal technical information such as the size of the GPT-4 model.

Background
OpenAI introduced the first GPT model (GPT-1) in 2018, publishing a paper called "Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training." It was based on the transformer architecture and trained on a large corpus of books. The next year, they introduced GPT-2, a larger model that could generate coherent text. In 2020, they introduced GPT-3, a model with 100 times as many parameters as GPT-2, that could perform various tasks with few examples. GPT-3 was further improved into GPT-3.5, which was used to create the chatbot product ChatGPT. 
Rumors claim that GPT-4 has 1.76 trillion parameters, which was first estimated by the speed it was running and by George Hotz.

Capabilities
OpenAI stated that GPT-4 is "more reliable, creative, and able to handle much more nuanced instructions than GPT-3.5." They produced two versions of GPT-4, with context windows of 8,192 and 32,768 tokens, a significant improvement over GPT-3.5 and GPT-3, which were limited to 4,096 and 2,049 tokens respectively. Some of the capabilities of GPT-4 were predicted by OpenAI before training it, although other capabilities remained hard to predict due to breaks in downstream scaling laws. Unlike its predecessors, GPT-4 is a multimodal model: it can take images as well as text as input; this gives it the ability to describe the humor in unusual images, summarize text from screenshots, and answer exam questions that contain diagrams.To gain further control over GPT-4, OpenAI introduced the "system message", a directive in natural language given to GPT-4 in order to specify its tone of voice and task. For example, the system message can instruct the model to "be a Shakespearean pirate", in which case it will respond in rhyming, Shakespearean prose, or request it to "always write the output of [its] response in JSON", in which case the model will do so, adding keys and values as it sees fit to match the structure of its reply. In the examples provided by OpenAI, GPT-4 refused to deviate from its system message despite requests to do otherwise by the user during the conversation.When instructed to do so, GPT-4 can interact with external interfaces. For example, the model could be instructed to enclose a query within <search></search> tags to perform a web search, the result of which would be inserted into the model's prompt to allow it to form a response. This allows the model to perform tasks beyond its normal text-prediction capabilities, such as using APIs, generating images, and accessing and summarizing webpages.A 2023 article in Nature stated programmers have found GPT-4 useful for assisting in coding tasks (despite its propensity for error), such as finding errors in existing code and suggesting optimizations to improve performance. The article quoted a biophysicist who found that the time he required to port one of his programs from MATLAB to Python went down from days to "an hour or so". On a test of 89 security scenarios, GPT-4 produced code vulnerable to SQL injection attacks 5% of the time, an improvement over Github Copilot from the year 2021, which produced vulnerabilities 40% of the time.

Aptitude on standardized tests
GPT-4 demonstrates aptitude on several standardized tests. OpenAI claims that in their own testing the model received a score of 1410 on the SAT (94th percentile), 163 on the LSAT (88th percentile), and 298 on the Uniform Bar Exam (90th percentile). In contrast, OpenAI claims that GPT-3.5 received scores for the same exams in the 82nd, 40th, and 10th percentiles, respectively.
GPT-4 also passed an oncology exam, an engineering exam and a plastic surgery exam.

Medical applications
Researchers from Microsoft tested GPT-4 on medical problems and found "that GPT-4, without any specialized prompt crafting, exceeds the passing score on USMLE by over 20 points and outperforms earlier general-purpose models (GPT-3.5) as well as models specifically fine-tuned on medical knowledge (Med-PaLM, a prompt-tuned version of Flan-PaLM 540B)".A report by Microsoft has found that GPT-4 may act unreliably when used in the medical field. In their test example, GPT-4 added fabricated details to a patient's notes.In April 2023, Microsoft and Epic Systems announced that they will provide healthcare providers with GPT-4 powered systems for assisting in responding to questions from patients and analysing medical records.

Limitations
Like its predecessors, GPT-4 has been known to hallucinate, meaning that the outputs may include information not in the training data or that contradicts the user's prompt.GPT-4 also lacks transparency in its decision-making processes. If requested, the model is able to provide an explanation as to how and why it makes its decisions but these explanations are formed post-hoc; it's impossible to verify if those explanations truly reflect the actual process. In many cases, when asked to explain its logic, GPT-4 will give explanations that directly contradict its previous statements.

Bias
GPT-4 was trained in two stages. First, the model was given large datasets of text taken from the internet and trained to predict the next token (roughly corresponding to a word) in those datasets. Second, human reviews are used to fine-tune the system in a process called reinforcement learning from human feedback, which trains the model to refuse prompts which go against OpenAI's definition of harmful behavior, such as questions on how to perform illegal activities, advice on how to harm oneself or others, or requests for descriptions of graphic, violent, or sexual content.Microsoft researchers suggested GPT-4 may exhibit cognitive biases such as confirmation bias, anchoring, and base-rate neglect.

Training
OpenAI did not release the technical details of GPT-4; the technical report explicitly refrained from specifying the model size, architecture, or hardware used during either training or inference. While the report described that the model was trained using a combination of first supervised learning on a large dataset, then reinforcement learning using both human and AI feedback, it did not provide details of the training, including the process by which the training dataset was constructed, the computing power required, or any hyperparameters such as the learning rate, epoch count, or optimizer(s) used. The report claimed that "the competitive landscape and the safety implications of large-scale models" were factors that influenced this decision.Sam Altman stated that the cost of training GPT-4 was more than $100 million. News website Semafor claimed that they had spoken with "eight people familiar with the inside story" and found that GPT-4 had 1 trillion parameters.

## Kereta Api Persahabatan: Kisah Jalur Sutra Modern

**Karakter:**

*   **Aisha (16 tahun):** Siswi SMA yang cerdas dan tertarik pada isu-isu global.
*   **Rizky (17 tahun):** Teman Aisha, antusias dengan teknologi dan logistik.
*   **Pak Budi:** Guru Sejarah dan Geografi mereka yang bijaksana.

**Setting:**

Ruang kelas SMA saat jam pelajaran Geografi.

---

**Pak Budi:** "Selamat pagi, anak-anak! Hari ini kita akan menjelajahi sebuah proyek ambisius yang sedang dibangun di Asia Tengah dan Selatan. Pernahkah kalian membayangkan bagaimana cara barang-barang dari suatu negara bisa sampai ke negara lain yang sangat jauh dengan lebih cepat dan efisien?"

Aisha mengangkat tangan. "Tentu, Pak. Biasanya lewat kapal laut atau pesawat, kan? Tapi itu kan butuh waktu lama dan biaya mahal."

**Pak Budi:** "Tepat sekali, Aisha! Nah, di sinilah peran penting sebuah proyek infrastruktur bernama **Proyek Kereta Api Uzbekistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan** atau yang sering disingkat UAP Railway Project. Rizky, kamu tahu apa tujuan utama dari proyek ini?"

Rizky mengernyitkan dahi, mencoba mengingat. "Setahu saya, Pak, ini tentang menghubungkan negara-negara itu dengan kereta api, kan? Tapi apa manfaatnya secara spesifik?"

**Pak Budi:** "Pertanyaan bagus, Rizky! Tujuan utama proyek ini adalah **menciptakan jalur kereta api langsung antara Uzbekistan dan Pakistan, melewati wilayah Afghanistan.** Bayangkan, sebuah jalur sepanjang 573 kilometer yang akan menghubungkan Tashkent, ibu kota Uzbekistan, langsung ke Kabul di Afghanistan, dan terus ke Peshawar di Pakistan."

Aisha tampak penasaran. "Jadi, ini seperti jalan tol versi kereta api untuk perdagangan, Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Persis! Lebih dari itu, Aisha. Proyek ini secara spesifik bertujuan untuk **meningkatkan efisiensi perdagangan dan logistik** di kawasan tersebut. Saat ini, pengiriman barang antara Uzbekistan dan Pakistan bisa memakan waktu yang cukup lama karena harus melalui rute yang berliku atau menggunakan moda transportasi yang kurang efisien."

**Rizky:** "Berarti, dengan adanya kereta api ini, waktu pengiriman barang jadi lebih cepat, dong?"

**Pak Budi:** "Betul sekali! Salah satu target utamanya adalah **mengurangi waktu pengiriman kargo antara Uzbekistan dan Pakistan sekitar lima hari.** Bayangkan, lima hari lebih cepat! Itu keuntungan besar bagi para pedagang dan industri."

**Aisha:** "Wow, itu signifikan sekali! Tapi, bagaimana cara kerja kereta api ini bisa membuat perdagangan jadi lebih efisien, Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Ada beberapa cara, Aisha. Pertama, **kecepatan.** Kereta api bisa mengangkut barang dalam jumlah besar dengan kecepatan yang relatif stabil dibandingkan truk yang sering terhambat kondisi jalan atau perbatasan. Kedua, **kapasitas.** Satu rangkaian kereta api bisa membawa muatan yang setara dengan puluhan atau bahkan ratusan truk. Ini berarti biaya per unit barang akan lebih murah."

**Rizky:** "Jadi, lebih murah dan lebih cepat. Itu pasti bikin barang-barang jadi lebih terjangkau, ya Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Betul sekali, Rizky. Dengan biaya logistik yang lebih rendah, harga jual barang bisa lebih kompetitif. Ini akan **memperkuat hubungan dagang antara Pakistan dan Asia Selatan** karena barang-barang dari Uzbekistan bisa sampai lebih mudah ke pasar-pasar di Pakistan dan sekitarnya. Begitu pula sebaliknya."

**Aisha:** "Jalurnya akan melewati kota-kota mana saja, Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Jalur kereta api ini akan melewati Termez di Uzbekistan, kemudian masuk ke Afghanistan melalui Mazar-i-Sharif dan Logar, lalu berlanjut ke perbatasan Kharlachi di distrik Kurram, Pakistan. Ini adalah jalur strategis yang menghubungkan pusat-pusat ekonomi penting."

**Rizky:** "Apakah ini hanya untuk barang saja, Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Tidak, Rizky. Kereta api ini dirancang untuk **melayani baik penumpang maupun kargo.** Jadi, selain barang, masyarakat juga bisa bepergian antar negara dengan lebih mudah. Ini akan **mendorong perdagangan regional dan berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan ekonomi secara keseluruhan** di wilayah tersebut."

**Aisha:** "Berarti proyek ini bukan cuma tentang ekonomi, tapi juga tentang konektivitas antar masyarakat, ya Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Tepat sekali, Aisha. Selain itu, proyek sebesar ini juga akan **menciptakan lapangan kerja** selama fase konstruksi, dan juga menyediakan **peluang kerja berkelanjutan** di sektor transportasi dan logistik setelah beroperasi. Peningkatan konektivitas ini juga akan **menarik investasi** baru dan **memicu pembangunan ekonomi** di daerah sekitar stasiun kereta api."

**Rizky:** "Jadi, kesimpulannya, tujuan utamanya adalah memperlancar perdagangan dan logistik, tapi efeknya bisa sampai ke mana-mana, ya Pak?"

**Pak Budi:** "Persis! Proyek Kereta Api Uzbekistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan ini diharapkan memiliki **efek transformatif pada kawasan.** Ini akan **meningkatkan perdagangan, memperkuat kerja sama regional** antara ketiga negara, dan **berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan serta pembangunan ekonomi** di Afghanistan dan Pakistan. Ini adalah contoh nyata bagaimana infrastruktur bisa menjadi jembatan menuju masa depan yang lebih makmur."

Aisha dan Rizky mengangguk-angguk, kini dengan pemahaman yang lebih jelas tentang pentingnya proyek kereta api tersebut. Mereka menyadari bahwa di balik jalur baja dan gerbong-gerbong itu, ada harapan besar untuk kemajuan dan persahabatan antar bangsa.

Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What is the objective of the Uzbekistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan Railway Project and how is it expected to enhance trade and logistics efficiency?

target_age: "15-18"
story_style: "educational"
language: "Indonesian"

Context:
The Uzbekistan–Afghanistan–Pakistan Railway Project is an extensive project undertaking with the objective of creating a direct railway link between Uzbekistan and Pakistan, passing through Afghanistan's territory. This project aims to enhance trade and logistics efficiency by establishing a 573-km rail connection that would connect Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan, to Kabul and Peshawar, the capitals of Afghanistan and Pakistan, respectively.

Project Details
The estimated cost of the project is US$4.8 billion, and its implementation is anticipated to strengthen trade relations between Pakistan and South Asia. The trilateral agreement spanning 760 kilometers was signed by Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Uzbekistan, aiming to significantly reduce cargo delivery times between Uzbekistan and Pakistan by approximately five days.The railway route will traverse through Termez, Mazar-i-Sharif, and Logar in Afghanistan, and continue to the Kharlachi border crossing in Pakistan's northwestern Kurram district. Designed to facilitate both passenger and freight services, the railway is poised to foster regional trade and contribute to overall economic growth in the area.

{"final_story": "## Misi PSLV-C56: Menjelajahi Angkasa dari Bumi Pertiwi

Pagi itu, di sebuah sekolah menengah di pinggir kota, terdengar riuh rendah suara siswa yang bersemangat. Hari itu adalah hari diskusi klub sains, dan topik yang diangkat tidak lain adalah misi luar angkasa terbaru. Di depan kelas, berdiri seorang guru muda yang enerjik, Ibu Rina, dengan senyum ramah yang menyambut setiap pertanyaan.

"Selamat pagi, anak-anak!" sapa Ibu Rina. "Hari ini kita akan membahas sesuatu yang sangat menarik, sebuah misi luar angkasa yang akan segera diluncurkan oleh ISRO, Badan Antariksa India. Ada yang sudah tahu tentang misi PSLV-C56?"

Beberapa tangan langsung terangkat. Salah satunya adalah Bima, siswa paling antusias di klub sains. "Saya, Bu! Saya pernah membaca sekilas, tapi belum terlalu paham detailnya."

"Bagus sekali, Bima! Nah, mari kita bedah bersama. Misi PSLV-C56 ini adalah misi ke-58 bagi kendaraan peluncur Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) milik ISRO. PSLV ini ibarat taksi luar angkasa yang mengantarkan satelit-satelit ke orbitnya," jelas Ibu Rina, sambil menunjuk sebuah gambar roket di layar proyektor. "Dan yang akan digunakan kali ini adalah varian PSLV-CA, penerbangan ke-17 dari varian tersebut."

"Bu, kenapa namanya PSLV-CA? Apa bedanya dengan PSLV yang lain?" tanya Sita, siswi yang selalu ingin tahu.

"Pertanyaan bagus, Sita! PSLV memiliki beberapa varian, dan 'CA' di sini menandakan 'Core Alone', artinya konfigurasi tanpa pendorong strap-on tambahan. Setiap varian disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan dan berat muatan satelit yang akan dibawa. Ini menunjukkan fleksibilitas dan keunggulan teknologi PSLV," jawab Ibu Rina.

"Jadi, Bu, kapan sebenarnya roket ini akan diluncurkan?" Bima kembali bertanya, tampak tidak sabar.

Ibu Rina tersenyum. "Nah, ini dia inti dari diskusi kita. Misi PSLV-C56 dijadwalkan akan diluncurkan pada **Minggu, 30 Juli 2023**. Waktu peluncurannya adalah pukul **06:30 IST (Indian Standard Time)**. Atau, jika kita konversi ke waktu universal terkoordinasi, itu berarti pukul **01:00 UTC**."

"Wah, berarti pagi sekali di India, ya, Bu," komentar Candra.

"Betul sekali, Candra. Dan yang lebih penting lagi, dari mana roket ini akan meluncur?" Ibu Rina melanjutkan. "Ada yang tahu markas besar peluncuran roket ISRO?"

"Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Bu!" seru beberapa siswa bersamaan.

"Tepat sekali! Misi ini akan diluncurkan dari **Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, India**. Lebih spesifik lagi, dari **First Launch Pad (FLP)** di sana."

"Satish Dhawan Space Centre itu apa, Bu?" tanya Rina, siswi pendiam yang jarang bertanya.

"Satish Dhawan Space Centre adalah pusat peluncuran utama ISRO. Bayangkan saja seperti bandara khusus untuk roket. Di sana ada berbagai fasilitas, mulai dari tempat perakitan roket, menara peluncuran, hingga pusat kendali misi. Sriharikota sendiri adalah sebuah pulau di pesisir timur India, lokasi yang strategis untuk peluncuran roket karena bisa meluncurkan satelit ke berbagai orbit dengan aman," jelas Ibu Rina.

"Jadi, Bu, ISRO itu apa? Apakah mereka hanya meluncurkan satelit untuk India saja?" tanya Bima lagi.

"ISRO, atau Indian Space Research Organisation, adalah badan antariksa pemerintah India yang didirikan pada tahun 1969. Tujuan utamanya adalah mengembangkan teknologi antariksa dan melakukan penelitian. Mereka bertanggung jawab atas program luar angkasa India, termasuk peluncuran satelit, eksplorasi antariksa, dan pengembangan teknologi terkait," papar Ibu Rina. "Dan tidak, Bima. ISRO tidak hanya meluncurkan satelit untuk India saja. Misi PSLV-C56 ini adalah contoh yang bagus. Ini adalah misi komersial khusus melalui NSIL (NewSpace India Limited), anak perusahaan ISRO. Satelit utama yang akan dibawa adalah DS-SAR, dan ada juga satelit VELOX-AM sebagai co-passenger, serta lima satelit lainnya. Menariknya, **semua satelit dalam misi ini berasal dari Singapura**."

Mata para siswa membulat kaget. "Wow! Berarti India membantu negara lain meluncurkan satelitnya, Bu?" tanya Sita tak percaya.

"Tepat sekali, Sita! Ini menunjukkan bahwa ISRO memiliki reputasi internasional yang kuat dalam menyediakan layanan peluncuran satelit yang andal dan hemat biaya. Mereka telah mencapai banyak tonggak penting, seperti meluncurkan satelit pertamanya, Aryabhata, pada tahun 1975," kata Ibu Rina bangga.

"Jadi, Bu, kalau kita ingin menyaksikan peluncurannya, kita bisa menontonnya secara langsung dari rumah?" tanya Bima bersemangat.

"Tentu saja, Bima! Biasanya ISRO akan menyiarkan peluncuran secara langsung melalui kanal YouTube mereka atau situs web resmi. Jadi, kalian bisa mencatat tanggal dan waktunya, dan menjadi saksi sejarah peluncuran misi PSLV-C56!"

{"final_story": "Tentu, mari kita buat cerita edukatif yang menarik untuk siswa usia 15-18 tahun.

## Jejak Baja di Ulan-Ude: Misteri Brigade Tank ke-5

Pagi itu, di sebuah aula kelas yang dipenuhi poster-poster sejarah militer, Pak Budi, guru sejarah yang selalu antusias, memulai pelajaran dengan senyum misterius. “Hari ini, kita akan mengungkap sebuah misteri, anak-anak,” katanya, menunjuk ke sebuah peta besar Rusia yang terpampang di dinding. “Misteri tentang sebuah unit militer yang jejaknya membentang dari masa lalu hingga konflik modern.”

Rina, siswi yang selalu ingin tahu, mengangkat tangan. “Misteri apa, Pak? Apakah ada harta karun tersembunyi?”

Pak Budi tertawa kecil. “Lebih dari itu, Rina. Ini tentang identitas. Pernahkah kalian mendengar tentang **Brigade Tank Pengawal Terpisah ke-5 Tatsin Panji Merah Ordo Suvorov**?”

Kelas hening. Nama yang panjang dan rumit itu membuat beberapa siswa mengerutkan kening.

“Kalian mungkin belum pernah, dan itu wajar,” lanjut Pak Budi. “Nama ini mencerminkan sejarah panjang dan berat. Tapi, dua pertanyaan penting yang akan kita pecahkan hari ini adalah: **Kapan Brigade ini dibentuk, dan berapa nomor unit militernya?**”

Andi, yang duduk di barisan depan, menyahut, “Wah, ini seperti detektif sejarah, Pak!”

“Tepat sekali, Andi! Mari kita mulai penyelidikan kita.” Pak Budi memutar proyektor, menampilkan sebuah slide dengan gambar tank modern. “Brigade ini adalah formasi militer Angkatan Darat Rusia. Mereka beroperasi di bawah Angkatan Bersenjata Gabungan ke-36 di Distrik Militer Timur, dan markas mereka berada di Ulan-Ude, Republik Buryatia.”

“Ulan-Ude? Itu jauh sekali di Siberia, kan, Pak?” tanya Lia.

“Betul sekali, Lia. Lokasi strategis. Sekarang, mari kita bahas tentang ‘kapan’. Banyak unit militer memiliki sejarah yang berakar pada unit-unit lama. Brigade Tank ke-5 ini adalah penerus dari **Korps Tank Pengawal ke-2**. Korps-korps tank ini memiliki sejarah gemilang di Perang Dunia II. Namun, formasi yang kita bicarakan ini, Brigade Tank Pengawal Terpisah ke-5, adalah unit yang lebih modern.”

Pak Budi berhenti sejenak, membiarkan informasi itu meresap. “Setelah restrukturisasi dan modernisasi angkatan bersenjata Rusia, unit ini secara resmi **dibentuk pada tahun 2009**.”

Mata Rina berbinar. “Jadi, Brigade Tank ke-5 yang sekarang ini baru dibentuk tahun 2009, Pak?”

“Tepat sekali, Rina. Meskipun mereka membawa nama dan kehormatan dari unit-unit pendahulu, formasi spesifik ini dimulai pada tahun 2009.” Pak Budi kemudian menggeser slide ke gambar sebuah lambang militer dengan angka. “Nah, sekarang pertanyaan kedua: Nomor unit militernya. Setiap unit militer memiliki identifikasi unik, semacam nomor induk. Ini penting untuk logistik, komunikasi, dan identifikasi di lapangan.”

“Apakah itu seperti nomor seri di barang-barang, Pak?” tanya Kevin.

“Bisa dibilang begitu, Kevin. Nomor ini adalah kode resmi mereka. Dan untuk Brigade Tank Pengawal Terpisah ke-5 ini, nomor unit militernya adalah **46108**.”

Pak Budi melihat sekeliling kelas. “Jadi, kita sudah menjawab dua pertanyaan utama kita. Brigade ini dibentuk pada tahun 2009, dan nomor unit militernya adalah 46108.”

“Tapi, Pak, kenapa namanya begitu panjang dan ada ‘Tatsin’ dan ‘Suvorov’?” tanya Andi.

“Pertanyaan bagus, Andi! Itu menunjukkan penghargaan atas keberanian dan prestasi mereka. ‘Tatsin’ merujuk pada operasi militer penting di masa lalu, dan ‘Ordo Suvorov’ adalah salah satu penghargaan militer tertinggi di Rusia, menunjukkan keunggulan strategis dan taktis. Mereka mewarisi kehormatan ini dari unit pendahulu mereka.”

Pak Budi melanjutkan, “Brigade ini bukan hanya unit yang berdiri diam di Ulan-Ude. Mereka telah terlibat dalam konflik-konflik modern. Misalnya, pada tahun 2015, Brigade Tank ke-5 terbukti menjadi salah satu unit Angkatan Darat Rusia yang aktif berpartisipasi dalam Perang di Donbass, khususnya dalam Pertempuran Debaltseve.”

Rina terlihat serius. “Jadi, mereka benar-benar terlibat dalam pertempuran nyata, Pak?”

“Ya, Rina. Dan keterlibatan mereka tidak berhenti di situ. Pada 5 Desember 2016, komandan brigade mereka, Kolonel Ruslan Galitsky, gugur dalam tugas saat unit tersebut dikerahkan ke Suriah untuk mendukung intervensi militer Rusia dalam Perang Saudara Suriah. Kolonel Galitsky memimpin brigade tanknya dalam operasi ofensif melawan pasukan pemberontak ketika dia terkena tembakan musuh.”

Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: When was the 5th Separate Guards Tatsin Red Banner Order of Suvorov Tank Brigade formed, and what is its military unit number?

target_age: "15-18"
story_style: "educational"
language: "Indonesian"

Context:
The 5th Separate Guards Tatsin Red Banner Order of Suvorov Tank Brigade (Russian: 5-я отдельная гвардейская танковая Тацинская Краснознамённая, ордена Суворова бригада) is a military formation of the Russian Ground Forces. It is subordinate to the 36th Combined Arms Army of the Eastern Military District and is garrisoned in Ulan-Ude, Republic of Buryatia. Its military unit number is 46108.

History
Formed in 2009, the 5th Tank Brigade is the successor formation to the 2nd Guards Tank Corps.In 2015 the 5th Tank Brigade was shown to be one of the Russian army units actively participating in the War in Donbass as opposed to units of the paramilitaries of the Donetsk and Lugansk People's Republics. The 5th Tank Brigade had been present in the Battle of Devaltseve.On December 5 2016 the brigade commander Colonel Ruslan Galitsky was killed in action as the unit was deployed to Syria.


== References ==

to support the Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War. Colonel Galitsky was leading his tank brigade in an offensive operation against rebel forces when he was hit by enemy fire.

The loss of Colonel Galitsky was a significant blow to the 5th Tank Brigade and the Russian military as a whole. He was known for his leadership skills and tactical expertise, and his death was mourned by his comrades and superiors.

Despite the loss of their commander, the 5th Tank Brigade continued to carry out their mission in Syria. They played a crucial role in supporting the Syrian government forces and their allies in their fight against rebel and terrorist groups.

The 5th Tank Brigade's involvement in the Syrian conflict highlighted Russia's commitment to supporting the Assad regime and maintaining its influence in the region. The brigade's tanks and armored vehicles provided firepower and protection to ground forces, helping to turn the tide of the war in favor of the Syrian government.

The death of Colonel Galitsky served as a reminder of the risks and sacrifices that Russian military personnel face in their operations abroad. It also underscored the importance of strong leadership and the need for capable commanders to guide and inspire their troops in the face of adversity.

{"item_idx": 45, "source": "2022 Sheffield gas supply outage", "language": "id", "question_raw": "Question: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?", "question": "What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?", "user_message": "Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?", "context_type": "v1+v2_merged_dedup", "merged_contexts": ["The city of Sheffield, England was impacted by a major failure of the local natural gas supply network in December 2022, resulting in a loss of central heating and gas stove availability to more than 3,000 properties in the northwestern suburbs of the city. The outage, which has predominantly affected the Hillsborough, Malin Bridge and Stannington districts, was declared a major incident by Sheffield City Council; some properties were without a gas supply for almost two weeks.
The gas supply outage affected the Cadent Gas network, and was caused by a burst water main on the Yorkshire Water network which resulted in more than 2 million litres of water flooding into the gas supply network. Yorkshire Water confirmed that the breach to the water main had been resolved by 6 December. In addition to the widespread gas supply outage, numerous properties in the affected areas have also suffered from outages to their water and electricity supplies as knock-on effects.Heavy rainfall initially hampered recovery work, followed by cold temperatures and snowfall. In response to the widespread lack of heating availability and increasingly cold temperatures, dropping as low as −3 °C (27 °F) on 9 December, a major incident was declared by local authorities. The Red Cross distributed aid, including food, drinks and blankets, to residents in the affected area.

Timeline
During the evening of 2 December, a water main on Bankfield Lane at the western end of Stannington burst, resulting in flooding in the local area. The affected water main was an asbestos-cement mainline pipe installed in 1970. More than 2 million litres of water, roughly equivalent to three Olympic-sized swimming pools, entered the gas mains in this area and subsequently flowed through pipes down hillsides throughout the Stannington and Hillsborough areas.Property damage was reported in dozens of homes across the affected area, including on High Matlock Road, as water overflowed out of gas meters and gas stoves inside homes; water also overflowed out of manhole covers and the bases of street lights in outdoor areas. Emergency services attended the incident from around midnight, going from door to door to wake residents. Cadent Gas, who operate the natural gas network in the area, described the incident as "unpredecented" and something which they had never had to deal with before.By 3 December more than 1,000 properties were without a gas supply; in addition, many properties in the immediate area of the burst water main also suffered from reduced water supplies, or no water at all, for several days. Engineers from Cadent Gas initially had to go from door to door and turn off the gas supply at each individual affected property, before engineers could commence work to drain and repair the gas network; more than 100 engineers were drafted in to work 24 hours a day to resolve the outage, later rising to more than 200 as the incident progressed.The number of properties affected by the gas supply outage rose to more than 2,000 by 6 December, increasingly affecting homes lower down the hillside in the Hillsborough area of Sheffield. Local electricity network operator Northern Powergrid warned local residents to only use portable electric heaters in occupied rooms and only while residents were at home, in order to reduce strain on the local power supply caused by increased usage of electric heating. Despite this however, residents on some streets in Stannington began to report intermittent power outages throughout the day. Electric car owners were advised to use public charging points rather than those at their own homes.The local authority, Sheffield City Council, officially declared a major incident on 7 December, with thousands of properties still without a gas supply and temperatures forecast to drop below freezing for prolonged periods in the coming days. Only around a quarter of affected properties had had their gas supplies reconnected at the time that the major incident was declared, according to Cadent Gas, as their engineers were struggling to pump the large quantities of water out of the complex local gas network; engineers and equipment were shipped in from across the country to assist in draining the network.According to Cadent Gas, around three-quarters of affected properties had been reconnected to the gas network by 10 December. Considerable difficulties remained in draining water from the gas network in the Hillsborough and Malin Bridge areas, where hundreds of homes still remained without gas.

Response
Refuge spaces were opened officially by the local authorities and unofficially by local businesses, providing warm spaces, hot food and drinks to affected residents. The primary official refuge was opened at Lomas Hall, a church hall on Church Street in Stannington, where residents were issued with portable electric heaters and electric hotplates for cooking. The Peacock Inn pub on Stannington Road opened to provide residents with food and hot drinks, while the nearby Crown & Glove pub on Uppergate Road opened to provide showering facilities.Schools in the affected areas remained open, despite the interruption to their gas supplies; individual classrooms were heated using portable electric heaters, and Nook Lane Junior School advised parents to send children to school wearing additional warm clothing and with a packed lunch due to the unavailability of their kitchen facilities.The Liberal Democrat councillor for the Stannington ward, Penny Baker, praised local residents for showing resilience and "community spirit" by coming together in the face of the crisis. Terry Fox, the leader of Sheffield City Council, declared a major incident on 7 December, stating that it would allow the local authorities to "better co-ordinate the overall response" to the crisis.Olivia Blake, the Labour Member of Parliament for the Sheffield Hallam constituency in which Stannington is located, raised the gas supply outage during a debate in the House of Commons on 7 December, asking for direct government assistance and emergency funding.

Aftermath
Yorkshire Water issued an apology to affected customers on 6 December, stating that they "understood how difficult it was" for affected residents. The water company was criticised for their part in causing the crisis, although a spokesperson maintained that the affected water main had previously been in a good condition and had not suffered any problems in more than a decade. Cadent Gas initially announced that residents would be compensated for any extra electricity usage caused by increased usage of portable electric heaters and other devices, before confirming that affected residents would receive double the usual rate of compensation for a gas outage, totalling £910 for a seven-day outage (or £1,470 for a commercial property).Angry local residents interrupted a news conference being held by Yorkshire Water director Neil Dewis in Stannington on 9 December, heckling him and accusing the company of not taking the situation seriously. Residents claimed that there had been up to ten recent burst water mains in the Stannington area prior to the major incident, accusing Yorkshire Water of providing inadequate maintenance. In contrast, efforts by Cadent Gas and Northern Powergrid to deal with the crisis were praised by local residents.Cadent appointed Aspect Maintenance from London as major contractor to replace hundreds of damaged gas appliances by 45 Engineers working 12 hours each day 7 days a week for 4 months.

Northern Powergrid also worked tirelessly to restore power to affected areas. They deployed additional engineers and resources to repair damaged power lines and restore electricity to homes as quickly as possible.

Local residents praised both companies for their swift response and efficient handling of the crisis. They appreciated the efforts made to prioritize their safety and comfort during a difficult time.

Overall, the response by Cadent Gas and Northern Powergrid to the crisis was seen as exemplary by local residents. Their quick action and dedication to restoring essential services were greatly appreciated."]}

{"final_story": "Tentu, ini adalah cerita edukatif yang dirancang untuk siswa usia 15-18 tahun, menjelaskan pemadaman pasokan gas di Sheffield pada Desember 2022.

---

## Kisah Pemadaman Gas Sheffield: Ketika Air Bertemu Api (Dan Mengapa Itu Buruk)

Musim dingin Desember 2022 di Sheffield, Inggris, seharusnya menjadi waktu yang nyaman, penuh dengan kehangatan perapian dan makanan hangat. Namun, bagi ribuan keluarga di pinggiran barat laut kota, terutama di Hillsborough, Malin Bridge, dan Stannington, kenyamanan itu tiba-tiba lenyap. Pemanas sentral mereka mati, kompor gas mereka tidak berfungsi. Mereka terjebak dalam cuaca dingin, dan penyebabnya adalah sebuah insiden yang luar biasa.

**Apa yang Terjadi? Titik Awal Kekacauan**

Bayangkan sebuah pipa air, yang tersembunyi di bawah tanah, diam-diam membawa air ke rumah-rumah. Sekarang, bayangkan pipa itu tiba-tiba pecah. Itulah yang terjadi pada malam tanggal 2 Desember 2022, di Bankfield Lane, Stannington. Sebuah pipa utama air yang sudah tua, dipasang pada tahun 1970, pecah. Tapi ini bukan sekadar kebocoran kecil.

**Penyebab Utama: Banjir yang Tak Terduga**

Pipa air yang pecah ini melepaskan lebih dari 2 juta liter air—setara dengan sekitar tiga kolam renang ukuran Olimpiade! Dan inilah bagian yang paling mengerikan: air sebanyak itu tidak hanya membanjiri jalanan. Entah bagaimana, air itu menyusup ke dalam jaringan pipa gas alam di area tersebut.

Bayangkan pipa gas Anda, yang seharusnya hanya berisi gas, tiba-tiba dipenuhi air. Ini seperti mengisi mesin mobil dengan air alih-alih bensin—tidak akan berfungsi, dan justru bisa menyebabkan kerusakan serius.

**Dampak Langsung: Kekacauan di Rumah dan Jalanan**

Dalam semalam, air mulai mengalir melalui pipa gas, menuruni lereng bukit, memasuki rumah-rumah di Stannington dan Hillsborough. Warga melaporkan air meluap dari meteran gas dan kompor gas di dalam rumah mereka. Di luar, air memancar dari penutup lubang got dan dasar lampu jalan. Ini adalah pemandangan yang aneh dan mengkhawatirkan.

Petugas layanan darurat segera datang, mengetuk pintu warga di tengah malam untuk membangunkan mereka dan memperingatkan tentang bahaya. Cadent Gas, perusahaan yang mengelola jaringan gas, menyebut insiden ini "belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya." Mereka belum pernah menghadapi situasi seperti ini sebelumnya.

**Mengapa Ini Menjadi Masalah Besar?**

1.  **Kehilangan Pasokan Gas:** Lebih dari 1.000 properti langsung kehilangan pasokan gas mereka. Ini berarti tidak ada pemanas, tidak ada kompor, tidak ada air panas. Dalam cuaca dingin Desember, ini adalah masalah serius. Jumlah ini terus meningkat menjadi lebih dari 2.000 properti pada 6 Desember, terutama di daerah yang lebih rendah di Hillsborough.
2.  **Dampak Berantai:** Selain gas, beberapa properti juga kehilangan pasokan air dan listrik sebagai efek domino. Peningkatan penggunaan pemanas listrik portabel membebani jaringan listrik lokal, menyebabkan pemadaman listrik sesekali.
3.  **Kondisi Cuaca Ekstrem:** Hujan deras menghambat pekerjaan pemulihan di awal, diikuti oleh suhu dingin yang ekstrem dan bahkan salju. Suhu turun hingga -3 °C, membuat situasi semakin genting bagi warga tanpa pemanas.

**Berapa Lama Pemadaman Berlangsung?**

Pemadaman gas ini bukan masalah yang bisa diselesaikan dalam semalam. Cadent Gas harus mengerahkan ratusan insinyur, bekerja 24 jam sehari, 7 hari seminggu. Tugas mereka adalah:
*   Mematikan pasokan gas satu per satu di setiap properti yang terkena dampak.
*   Memompa keluar jutaan liter air dari jaringan pipa gas yang kompleks.
*   Memastikan pipa gas benar-benar kering dan aman sebelum pasokan gas bisa dinyalakan kembali.

Buat cerita edukatif yang membantu siswa memahami: What caused the gas supply outage in Sheffield, England in December 2022, and how long did the outage last?

target_age: "15-18"
story_style: "educational"
language: "Indonesian"

Context:
The city of Sheffield, England was impacted by a major failure of the local natural gas supply network in December 2022, resulting in a loss of central heating and gas stove availability to more than 3,000 properties in the northwestern suburbs of the city. The outage, which has predominantly affected the Hillsborough, Malin Bridge and Stannington districts, was declared a major incident by Sheffield City Council; some properties were without a gas supply for almost two weeks.
The gas supply outage affected the Cadent Gas network, and was caused by a burst water main on the Yorkshire Water network which resulted in more than 2 million litres of water flooding into the gas supply network. Yorkshire Water confirmed that the breach to the water main had been resolved by 6 December. In addition to the widespread gas supply outage, numerous properties in the affected areas have also suffered from outages to their water and electricity supplies as knock-on effects.Heavy rainfall initially hampered recovery work, followed by cold temperatures and snowfall. In response to the widespread lack of heating availability and increasingly cold temperatures, dropping as low as −3 °C (27 °F) on 9 December, a major incident was declared by local authorities. The Red Cross distributed aid, including food, drinks and blankets, to residents in the affected area.

Timeline
During the evening of 2 December, a water main on Bankfield Lane at the western end of Stannington burst, resulting in flooding in the local area. The affected water main was an asbestos-cement mainline pipe installed in 1970. More than 2 million litres of water, roughly equivalent to three Olympic-sized swimming pools, entered the gas mains in this area and subsequently flowed through pipes down hillsides throughout the Stannington and Hillsborough areas.Property damage was reported in dozens of homes across the affected area, including on High Matlock Road, as water overflowed out of gas meters and gas stoves inside homes; water also overflowed out of manhole covers and the bases of street lights in outdoor areas. Emergency services attended the incident from around midnight, going from door to door to wake residents. Cadent Gas, who operate the natural gas network in the area, described the incident as "unpredecented" and something which they had never had to deal with before.By 3 December more than 1,000 properties were without a gas supply; in addition, many properties in the immediate area of the burst water main also suffered from reduced water supplies, or no water at all, for several days. Engineers from Cadent Gas initially had to go from door to door and turn off the gas supply at each individual affected property, before engineers could commence work to drain and repair the gas network; more than 100 engineers were drafted in to work 24 hours a day to resolve the outage, later rising to more than 200 as the incident progressed.The number of properties affected by the gas supply outage rose to more than 2,000 by 6 December, increasingly affecting homes lower down the hillside in the Hillsborough area of Sheffield. Local electricity network operator Northern Powergrid warned local residents to only use portable electric heaters in occupied rooms and only while residents were at home, in order to reduce strain on the local power supply caused by increased usage of electric heating. Despite this however, residents on some streets in Stannington began to report intermittent power outages throughout the day. Electric car owners were advised to use public charging points rather than those at their own homes.The local authority, Sheffield City Council, officially declared a major incident on 7 December, with thousands of properties still without a gas supply and temperatures forecast to drop below freezing for prolonged periods in the coming days. Only around a quarter of affected properties had had their gas supplies reconnected at the time that the major incident was declared, according to Cadent Gas, as their engineers were struggling to pump the large quantities of water out of the complex local gas network; engineers and equipment were shipped in from across the country to assist in draining the network.According to Cadent Gas, around three-quarters of affected properties had been reconnected to the gas network by 10 December. Considerable difficulties remained in draining water from the gas network in the Hillsborough and Malin Bridge areas, where hundreds of homes still remained without gas.

Response
Refuge spaces were opened officially by the local authorities and unofficially by local businesses, providing warm spaces, hot food and drinks to affected residents. The primary official refuge was opened at Lomas Hall, a church hall on Church Street in Stannington, where residents were issued with portable electric heaters and electric hotplates for cooking. The Peacock Inn pub on Stannington Road opened to provide residents with food and hot drinks, while the nearby Crown & Glove pub on Uppergate Road opened to provide showering facilities.Schools in the affected areas remained open, despite the interruption to their gas supplies; individual classrooms were heated using portable electric heaters, and Nook Lane Junior School advised parents to send children to school wearing additional warm clothing and with a packed lunch due to the unavailability of their kitchen facilities.The Liberal Democrat councillor for the Stannington ward, Penny Baker, praised local residents for showing resilience and "community spirit" by coming together in the face of the crisis. Terry Fox, the leader of Sheffield City Council, declared a major incident on 7 December, stating that it would allow the local authorities to "better co-ordinate the overall response" to the crisis.Olivia Blake, the Labour Member of Parliament for the Sheffield Hallam constituency in which Stannington is located, raised the gas supply outage during a debate in the House of Commons on 7 December, asking for direct government assistance and emergency funding.

Aftermath
Yorkshire Water issued an apology to affected customers on 6 December, stating that they "understood how difficult it was" for affected residents. The water company was criticised for their part in causing the crisis, although a spokesperson maintained that the affected water main had previously been in a good condition and had not suffered any problems in more than a decade. Cadent Gas initially announced that residents would be compensated for any extra electricity usage caused by increased usage of portable electric heaters and other devices, before confirming that affected residents would receive double the usual rate of compensation for a gas outage, totalling £910 for a seven-day outage (or £1,470 for a commercial property).Angry local residents interrupted a news conference being held by Yorkshire Water director Neil Dewis in Stannington on 9 December, heckling him and accusing the company of not taking the situation seriously. Residents claimed that there had been up to ten recent burst water mains in the Stannington area prior to the major incident, accusing Yorkshire Water of providing inadequate maintenance. In contrast, efforts by Cadent Gas and Northern Powergrid to deal with the crisis were praised by local residents.Cadent appointed Aspect Maintenance from London as major contractor to replace hundreds of damaged gas appliances by 45 Engineers working 12 hours each day 7 days a week for 4 months.

Northern Powergrid also worked tirelessly to restore power to affected areas. They deployed additional engineers and resources to repair damaged power lines and restore electricity to homes as quickly as possible.

Local residents praised both companies for their swift response and efficient handling of the crisis. They appreciated the efforts made to prioritize their safety and comfort during a difficult time.

Overall, the response by Cadent Gas and Northern Powergrid to the crisis was seen as exemplary by local residents. Their quick action and dedication to restoring essential services were greatly appreciated.

{"final_story": "## The Unseen Chill: Afghanistan's January 2023 Cold Snap

**Characters:**

*   **Aisha:** A curious and empathetic high school student, interested in global events.
*   **Mr. Khan:** Aisha's history and geography teacher, knowledgeable and patient.
*   **Jamal:** A fictional Afghan teenager, representing those affected by the cold snap.

---

The fluorescent lights of the classroom hummed, a stark contrast to the biting winter winds Aisha could feel even through the thick windowpanes. Mr. Khan stood at the front, a world map projected behind him.

"Good morning, class," he began, his voice calm but with a subtle seriousness. "Today, we're going to step away from our usual curriculum for a moment and look at a recent event that had a profound impact. We're going to talk about the cold snap in Afghanistan in January 2023."

Aisha, usually quick to doodle in her notebook, put her pen down. She’d heard snippets on the news, but the full picture was still hazy.

"Imagine this," Mr. Khan continued, gesturing towards the map, "a country already facing immense challenges, suddenly plunged into an extreme winter. This wasn't just a few chilly days; it was a brutal, sustained cold that began around January 10th."

He clicked to the next slide, revealing an image of snow-covered mountains, beautiful yet ominous.

"Let's start with the raw numbers, which can be difficult to grasp without context. During this cold snap, temperatures in Afghanistan plummeted to an astonishing **-33 degrees Celsius, or -27 degrees Fahrenheit**."

A collective gasp rippled through the classroom. Aisha shivered, thinking of how cold -5°C felt on a school morning.

"To put that in perspective," Mr. Khan explained, "that's colder than the inside of most freezers. It’s a temperature that can cause frostbite in minutes if you’re not adequately protected. And it wasn't just the cold. Many mountainous regions experienced significant snowfall, with some areas receiving as much as **30 centimeters, or 12 inches, of snow**."

He paused, letting the information sink in. "Now, think about what those conditions mean for people. How do you stay warm? How do you travel? How do you find food?"

Aisha raised her hand. "Mr. Khan, how many people were affected by this? It sounds incredibly dangerous."

"An excellent question, Aisha," Mr. Khan nodded. "The human cost was devastating. This cold snap tragically led to the deaths of at least **162 people**. This made it the deadliest weather event of 2023 at the time, only later surpassed by Cyclone Freddy."

He clicked again, showing a graph. "But the impact wasn't just from exposure to the cold. In one province, Herat, at least 140 people were hospitalized due to **carbon monoxide poisoning**. Can anyone guess why?"

Another student, Ben, ventured, "Because they were trying to stay warm indoors, maybe with unsafe heating methods?"

"Exactly, Ben," Mr. Khan confirmed. "When people are desperate to escape such extreme cold, they might use charcoal braziers or improperly ventilated gas heaters, leading to this silent, deadly threat."

Aisha felt a pang of sadness. It wasn't just the cold, but the desperate measures people had to take to survive it.

"And it wasn't just people who suffered," Mr. Khan continued, his voice softening slightly. "Afghanistan is an agrarian society, and livestock are crucial for sustenance and income. During this cold snap, over **77,000 livestock perished**."

Aisha imagined families losing their entire herds, their livelihoods vanishing overnight. "That's a huge number, Mr. Khan. How could they recover from that?"

"It's an immense challenge, Aisha. And to make matters worse, this cold snap hit Afghanistan when the country was already in the grip of a severe famine, affecting more than half its population. Imagine being hungry, then facing these deadly temperatures and losing your animals."

He explained the complex geopolitical situation. "Following the 2021 Taliban offensive, Afghanistan had become somewhat isolated on the global stage. This meant that when this disaster struck, foreign aid was very limited at first. Providing relief was incredibly difficult."

"But people must have tried to help, right?" Aisha asked, hope in her voice.

"Yes, they did. Humanitarian efforts were mobilized, providing things like heating supplies and financial aid. However, there were significant obstacles. For instance, a ban on women working in humanitarian roles complicated efforts. Imagine trying to reach and assist women and children in conservative communities without female aid workers."

He showed an image of aid workers distributing blankets. "Fortunately, these restrictions were somewhat relaxed for health-related aid on January 17th. This allowed crucial organizations like the International Rescue Committee, Save the Children, and Care International to resume some of their vital operations."

"Were they able to reach everyone?" Ben asked.

"Unfortunately, no. Military helicopters were used to deliver aid to some communities cut off by the snow. But even these couldn't access all of Afghanistan's incredibly rugged, mountainous regions. Some people were simply too isolated."

Mr. Khan clicked to the last slide, a simple world map highlighting Afghanistan. "This event in January 2023 serves as a powerful reminder of several things. Firstly, the devastating power of extreme weather, especially when combined with existing vulnerabilities. Secondly, the interconnectedness of global challenges – how political situations can impact humanitarian responses. Create an educational story that helps students understand: What were the temperatures and snowfall amounts during the cold snap in Afghanistan in January 2023, and how many people and livestock were affected?

target_age: "15-18"
story_style: "educational"
language: "English"

Context:
A cold snap began in Afghanistan on January 10, 2023. Temperatures reached as low as −33 °C (−27 °F) and snowfall was as high as 30 centimetres (12 in) in more mountainous regions. The cold snap killed at least 160 people, making it the deadliest weather event of 2023 until Cyclone Freddy. Additionally, nearly 80,000 livestock were killed.

Impact
Temperatures fell to a low of −33 °C (−27 °F), with up to 30 centimetres (12 in) of snow in the higher mountain altitudes, directly or indirectly killing at least 162 people in various provinces. At least 140 people using gas for heating were hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning in Herat Province. Over 77,000 livestock died due to the weather. Over 50 houses were damaged across the country.

Relief
The cold came while Afghanistan was experiencing a famine that affected more than half of the Afghan population. The country had become a pariah state following the 2021 Taliban offensive and the reestablishment of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, leading to limited foreign aid.Humanitarian relief efforts provided aid that included heating and relief funds. Foreign relief efforts were complicated by a ban on women providing humanitarian aid. These restrictions were relaxed for health-related aid on January 17, so non-governmental organizations such as the International Rescue Committee, Save the Children, and Care International resumed operations. Supreme leader Hibatullah Akhundzada stated that the restrictions would not be repealed.Military helicopters were used to provide relief for citizens cut off by snow, but they were unable to access Afghanistan's mountainous regions.

**Ms. Chen:** It does! It’s a fantastic cross-section of the city. We then approach one of Shanghai's most famous areas: **People's Square**. Here, we'd see the **People's Government of Shanghai Municipality Building**, the impressive **Shanghai Museum**, the **Shanghai Grand Theatre**, and the historic **Grand Cinema**. Uber Technologies, Inc.  or Uber has been the subject of a number of controversies. These include both unethical business practices such as flouting local regulations and sabotaging competitors. It has also received criticism for its treatment of employees, facing claims of racial discrimination and sexual harassment in the workplace. Concerns have also been raised about Uber's retention of customer data, particularly in the wake of their handling of data leaks. These issues have led to the company being banned from operating in some countries.

Ignoring and evading local regulations
Uber has been criticized for its strategy of generally commencing operations in a city without regard for local regulations. If faced with regulatory opposition, Uber called for public support for its service and mounted a political campaign, supported by lobbying, to change regulations. Uber argued that it is "a technology company" and not a taxi company, and therefore it was not subject to regulations affecting taxi companies. Uber's strategy was generally to "seek forgiveness rather than permission". In 2014, with regards to airport pickups without a permit in California, drivers were actually told to ignore local regulations and that the company would pay for any citations. Uber's response to California Assembly Bill 5 (2019), whereby it announced that it would not comply with the law, then engaged lobbyists and mounted an expensive public opinion campaign to overturn it via a ballot, was cited as an example of this policy.  Taxi companies sued Uber in numerous American cities, alleging that Uber's policy of violating taxi regulations was a form of unfair competition or a violation of antitrust law. Although some courts did find that Uber intentionally violated the taxi rules, Uber prevailed in every case, including the only case to proceed to trial.In March 2017, an investigation by The New York Times revealed that Uber developed a software tool called "Greyball" to avoid giving rides to known law enforcement officers in areas where its service was illegal such as in Portland, Oregon, Australia, South Korea, and China. The tool identified government officials using geofencing, mining credit card databases, identifying devices, and searches of social media. While at first, Uber stated that it only used the tool to identify riders that violated its terms of service, after investigations by Portland, Oregon, and the United States Department of Justice, Uber admitted to using the tool to skirt local regulations and promised not to use the tool for that purpose. The use of Greyball in London was cited by Transport for London as one of the reasons for its decision not to renew Uber's private hire operator licence in September 2017.  A January 2018 report by Bloomberg News stated that Uber routinely used a "panic button" system, codenamed "Ripley", that locked, powered off and changed passwords on staff computers when those offices were subjected to government raids. Uber allegedly used this button at least 24 times, from spring 2015 until late 2016.

Attempts to sabotage competitors
In 2014, Uber employees were caught ordering and then quickly cancelling rides on competing services Lyft and Gett, in an attempt to disrupt these services. In 2014, Uber was also accused of recruiting people to use competing services for the sole purpose of recruiting their drivers to Uber, at which point the recruiter would receive a commission. Uber denied that it had any involvement with the cancellation of orders or the recruitment efforts.

Wage disputes
In January 2017, Uber agreed to pay $20 million to the Federal Trade Commission to resolve allegations of having misled drivers about potential earnings.In 2017, a class action lawsuit was filed on behalf of thousands of Uber drivers, alleging that Uber’s “upfront prices” policy did not provide drivers with the 80% of fares to which they were entitled. The lawsuit was settled for $345,622, with each driver in the class getting at least $20.In May 2017, after the New York Taxi Workers Alliance (NYTWA) filed a class-action lawsuit in federal court in New York, Uber admitted to underpaying New York City drivers tens of millions of dollars over 2.5 years by calculating driver commissions on a net amount. Uber agreed to pay the amounts owed plus interest.

Boycott in the US
In late January 2017, GrabYourWallet advised to boycott Uber because the company did not join its Protests against Executive Order 13769, while Travis Kalanick, then CEO of Uber, was a member of Donald Trump's "business advisory council" and GrabYourWallet was advising boycotts of businesses with ties to Trump. Approximately 200,000 users deleted the Uber mobile app. On February 2, 2017, Kalanick resigned from the council, which disbanded in August 2017.

Sexual harassment allegations and management shakeup (2017)
On February 19, 2017, former Uber engineer Susan Fowler published on her website that she was propositioned for sex by a manager and subsequently threatened with termination of employment by another manager if she continued to report the incident. Kalanick was alleged to have been aware of the complaint. On February 27, 2017, Amit Singhal, Uber's Senior Vice President of Engineering, was forced to resign after he failed to disclose a sexual harassment claim against him that occurred while he served as Vice President of Google Search. After investigations led by former attorney general Eric Holder and Arianna Huffington, a member of Uber's board of directors, in June 2017, Uber fired over 20 employees. Kalanick took an indefinite leave of absence but, under pressure from investors, he resigned as CEO a week later. Also departing the company in June 2017 was Emil Michael, a senior vice president who suggested that Uber hire a team of opposition researchers and journalists, with a million-dollar budget, to "dig up dirt" on the personal lives and backgrounds of media figures who reported negatively about Uber, specifically targeting Sarah Lacy, editor of PandoDaily, who, in an article published in October 2014, accused Uber of sexism and misogyny in its advertising. In August 2018, Uber agreed to pay a total of $7 million to settle claims of gender discrimination, harassment, and hostile work environment, with 480 employees and former employees receiving $10,700 each and 56 of those employees and former employees receiving an additional $33,900 each. In December 2019, Kalanick resigned from the board of directors of the company and sold his shares.

God view and privacy concerns
In November 2014, then U.S. Senator Al Franken, Chairman of the United States Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Privacy, Technology and the Law, expressed concerns regarding ride sharing privacy, specifically Uber's "God View", whereby the whereabouts of specific customers, including journalists and politicians, are able to be tracked by Uber insiders. In December 2014, in response to Franken, Uber implemented restrictions on that function.In 2012, an Uber employee tracked the frequency of probable one-night stands in six U.S. cities by day and neighborhood, by correlating late-night and next-day trips. The blog posting coined the term "ride of glory" for the Uber equivalent of a walk of shame.

Delayed disclosure of data breaches
On February 27, 2015, Uber admitted that it had suffered a data breach more than nine months prior. Names and license plate information from approximately 50,000 drivers were inadvertently disclosed. Uber discovered this leak in September 2014, but waited more than five months to notify the affected individuals.An announcement in November 2017 revealed that in 2016, a separate data breach had disclosed the personal information of 600,000 drivers and 57 million customers.
